X.import_asset(source_file_path, destination_folder, asset_name) -> (str, out_error=str)
Import an image file from disk into the Content Browser as a Texture2D.

Uses the texture factory's direct binary path (FactoryCreateBinary) rather than
AssetTools::ImportAssets/ImportAssetTasks. The high-level import APIs pump the
game-thread task graph, which asserts (RecursionGuard) when invoked from inside an
MCP tool call (those run inside an AsyncTask on the game thread). This path is safe
to call from execute_python_code and from the manage_asset 'import' action.

Supported formats: png, jpg, jpeg, bmp, tga, dds, exr, hdr, tiff, tif, psd, pcx.

Args:
    source_file_path (str): Absolute path to the image file on disk
    destination_folder (str): Content Browser folder (e.g. "/Game/UI/Textures")
    asset_name (str): Optional asset name; if empty, derived from the file name

Returns:
    str: The created asset's object path (e.g. "/Game/UI/Textures/T_Foo.T_Foo"), or empty on failure Example: path, err = unreal.AssetDiscoveryService.import_asset("C:/Images/rocks.jpg", "/Game/UI/Textures", "T_Rocks")

    out_error (str): Receives a human-readable error message on failure
